description: Simplified Student Aid Index estimate using the page formula: parent income at 22 percent plus parent assets at 12 percent, student income above the 11770 income protection allowance at 50 percent plus student assets at 20 percent, plus an estimated Pell Grant of 7395 minus the SAI, floored at zero. Use when the user estimates their FAFSA Student Aid Index. IMPORTANT: always show the calculator_url from the result as a clickable markdown link in your answer to the user, so they can open the interactive FAFSA SAI Estimator calculator.
